corpus_note: run-5 and run-6 scout corpora are near-identical sweeps (one item reordered: The-AIE/the-gibson); under the current history state they yield identical extractions. The committed record is weighted as-is (N=3) for ALL arms and the baseline alike — no arm-dependent asymmetry.
metric_formula: M(K) = (1/3) * sum over the three committed corpora of [ mu_c(K) + f_c(K) ], where score(item) = count of K's entries whose lowercase substring occurs in the item's JSON blob; pool = items with score >= 2; stable sort by score desc; dedup by normalized title keeping first; top-9; history conditioning (current mine ledger: mines.jsonl M1-M11 both-channel bare-id markers + engine-run-1..6 QRNG-drawn cards by normalized title); mu_c = mean score of SURVIVING candidates (0 if none); f_c = surviving count (the fresh-candidate count: candidates that would reach the priors stage as new cards).

decision_rule.bundle: M4/M10 budget cap as selection pressure: bundle budget B = max(1, ceil(B0 * ANNEAL^t)), B0=3, ANNEAL=0.7, t=0 prior E6 slices → B=3. Bundle = certified QRNG lead + (B-1) top-noul fills (noul desc, arm-index tie-break). ONLY bundle arms are measured; the other 5 arms stay frozen-unmeasured (never peeked).
decision_rule.anti_cherry_pick: the priors NEVER choose what gets measured — the binding lead is a certified comet-qrng-v1 draw over the frozen 8-arm list; the LLM choice is receipted as a reflective prior only
decision_rule.margin_note: 0.05 relative chosen a priori, before any arm measurement; paired with a hard no-recall-collapse floor (totalF >= 15) so precision cannot be bought with recall
decision_rule.fail_branch: if no measured bundle arm meets both conditions: seal FAIL verbatim in receipts/decide.json + verdict.md — no threshold surgery, no post-hoc metric revision, unmeasured arms stay frozen; failure_mode and next_probe named
decision_rule.boring_branch: if the gate fails only because arms are metric-inert (M equal to baseline within the margin AND totalF unchanged), the FAIL verdict additionally records mutation_space_inert: true

cost_rule.law: M10 (arXiv:2609.24972): added inference cost must be paid for by measured gain on the target

exactly 1 certified mothquantum comet-qrng-v1 seal (Fisher-Yates over the 8 frozen arms)
cost_rule.settlement: spend is PAID iff the verdict is PASS (a measured-better KEYS variant exists from the bundle); on FAIL or honest partial the receipt records NOT_PAID — the added spend bought an honest negative, not gain

budget_and_abort.abort_line: external channel failure (typesafe/mothquantum non-2xx or timeout) → fail-closed honest partial receipted; $0 untracked spend
